item.description: The Telegram plugin's URL parsing functionality is incomplete or broken, causing test_plugin_telegram_urls to fail. The plugin's parse_url method has issues with parsing complex Telegram URLs.
item.contract: Implement complete and robust URL parsing for Telegram notifications that properly handles all valid Telegram URL formats including bot tokens, chat IDs, topics, and query parameters. The parse_url method should correctly extract all components from URLs and populate the plugin's internal state.

item.description: The Apprise class lacks proper asynchronous notification support, causing test_apprise_async to fail. The async_notify method doesn't properly handle async operations or the underlying plugins don't support async.
item.contract: Ensure the Apprise class properly implements asynchronous notification support by adding async_notify() method that properly delegates to plugins that support async operations. The method should handle both sync and async plugins appropriately and return proper async results.

item.description: The GLib plugin's disabled state handling is incorrect, causing test_plugin_glib_disabled to fail. The plugin's enabled property and instantiation logic don't properly reflect disabled states.
item.contract: Ensure the GLib plugin properly handles disabled states by correctly implementing the enabled flag and ensuring that when a plugin is disabled, it properly returns None during instantiation instead of attempting to create an instance. The plugin should respect the enabled property throughout its lifecycle.
